goal: Interactive Yahoo price-history chart on run detail, overlaid with catalog bear/base/bull (and sibling session markers).
non_goals: Do not mutate archive/research or archive/outcomes history
Do not persist live prices into catalog sqlite
Do not invent or recompute FV/MoS
Do not add a ticker-level page this slice
Do not add a sqlite quote_symbol column or bump harness/VERSION
Do not fetch intraday bars (daily close only)
success_criteria: GET /api/price-history?symbol=&range= returns daily closes for one listing; FakeHistoryBackend in tests; cache + single-flight; invalid range/symbol is 400
Yahoo download/split/close lives in one helper used by last-print quotes and history
Run detail shows an interactive chart: range buttons 1M/3M/6M/1Y/2Y/5Y/MAX, price line, bear/base/bull levels from catalog, as-of marker, sibling session markers
Chart overlay JSON is catalog fields only (no Mode B FV)
